name: Period Portrait Serif Title
description: An anonymous period-dressed figure presents the episode's subject on one third of the canvas while a large two-line serif title fills the other two thirds over a dark painted ground.
composition_guidance: Divide the 16:9 canvas into one third and two thirds. On the one-third side, place a single anonymous period-dressed figure at bust, half, or three-quarter length, holding or presenting the episode's subject (a loaf, a tea caddy, a fork, a bundle of spice) with a warm rim light on the shoulder and a deep umber background. On the two-thirds side, render the complete episode title directly in the image as a two-line serif arrangement: a small first line in cream capitals and a very large second line in cream serif letters with a soft gold edge, vertically centred with generous dark space around it. The figure may sit on either side; the title always takes the wider side. The active Visual Style remains the final authority for medium, palette, texture, and lighting; this recipe controls only the split, the figure's role, and the title band.
composition_rules: One anonymous period figure on the narrower third, presenting the subject; never a recognisable person.
The complete episode title on the wider two thirds as two serif lines: small lead-in line, very large subject line.
Deep dark ground behind the title with no props, patterns, or secondary objects in the title area.
Warm rim light on the figure; title letters cream with a soft gold edge for card-size legibility.
Vary figure side, distance, era, and setting between episodes; keep the split and hierarchy fixed.
required_elements: One anonymous period-dressed figure presenting the episode subject
The model-rendered complete episode title as two serif lines on the wider side
A deep, uncluttered painted ground behind the title
avoid_elements: Recognisable or named people, portraits of real individuals
More than one figure, crowds, or busy backgrounds behind the title
Extra captions, numerals, badges, arrows, or emoji
Copied trade dress, logos, watermarks, or post-render typography compositing
Bright modern colours, hard digital edges, or photographic realism
headline_guidance: Render the complete intended episode title directly on the wider side as exactly two serif lines: the lead-in words small in cream capitals on the first line and the subject words very large on the second line. Use a third line only when the subject itself is long. Fail closed on misspelling, clipping, or any text beyond the episode title.
default_text_style: cream serif with soft gold edge
default_font_style: classic serif, small-caps lead-in over large subject line
visual_style_guidance: A painted, old-master atmosphere suits this recipe: dark umber ground, single warm rim light on the figure, subdued earth palette. The recipe governs the one-third/two-thirds split, the figure's presenting role, and the two-line serif title; the active Visual Style remains authoritative for every rendering choice.
